chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: The Savoy, the Apollo, and Sammy Davis Jr. on the bill
summary: Basie recalls Billie's success at the Apollo and Sammy Davis introducing her, and says he first saw Sammy in Memphis and insisted on having him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her
